user.title: Olimpia Splendid Unico
user.description: Choose how to add your device.

manual_ip.title: Manual Connection
manual_ip.description: Enter the device IP. Optionally paste the credentials JSON from the BLE pairing tool output (~/.olimpia/IP.json), or leave empty to load from disk.

ble_scan.title: BLE Device Scan
ble_scan.description: Select the Olimpia Splendid device found via Bluetooth.

ble_pin.title: BLE Pairing
ble_pin.description: Enter the device PIN and WiFi credentials.

ble_pairing.title: Pairing in progress
ble_pairing.description: BLE pairing and WiFi configuration in progress. This may take up to 60 seconds.

flap_sensor.title: Flap tilt sensor (optional)
flap_sensor.description: Select the vibration/tilt sensor glued to the flap and the axis to monitor. Leave empty to skip: the integration will still work, but only with the blind swing toggle. After setup, run the calibration from the integration options.

error.no_credentials: No credentials found. Run the BLE pairing tool first (see tools/ in the repository), then paste the JSON content above or copy the file to ~/.olimpia/ on your HA machine.
error.invalid_credentials_json: Invalid credentials JSON. Paste the full contents of the ~/.olimpia/IP.json file generated by the BLE pairing tool.
error.ble_no_devices: No Olimpia Splendid devices found via BLE
error.angle_entity_not_found: No angle entity found on that device for the selected axis. Check that the sensor exposes angle_x / angle_y / angle_z.

abort.ble_pairing_failed: BLE pairing failed. Check the device is in pairing mode and try again.

init.title: Olimpia Splendid Unico options
init.description: Choose what you want to do.

flap_sensor.title: Flap tilt sensor (optional)
flap_sensor.description: Change the tilt sensor device or the monitored axis. Changing the sensor discards the existing calibration.

progress.calibrating: Calibration in progress. The flap will move repeatedly: this takes about 3 to 5 minutes. Do not use the air conditioner meanwhile.

error.angle_entity_not_found: No angle entity found on that device for the selected axis. Check that the sensor exposes angle_x / angle_y / angle_z.

abort.calibration_done: Calibration completed. Travel limits and travel time have been saved.
abort.calibration_failed: Calibration failed. Check the logs: the most common causes are a wrong axis, an unresponsive sensor, or the air conditioner being off.
abort.flap_not_configured: Flap tilt sensor is not configured.

flap_ac_off.message: The air conditioner is off: the flap cannot be positioned.

flap_not_calibrated.message: The flap is not calibrated yet. Run the calibration first.

set_flap_angle.name: Set flap angle
set_flap_angle.description: Moves the flap to an absolute angle, within the calibrated limits.

angle.name: Angle
angle.description: Target angle in degrees, as reported by the tilt sensor.

calibrate_flap.name: Calibrate flap
calibrate_flap.description: Runs the automatic calibration to determine the travel limits and the travel time. Takes about 3 to 5 minutes.

home_flap.name: Home flap
home_flap.description: Re-synchronises the known flap position by stopping it and reading the tilt sensor.
